title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 (Build 30) — Universal Public QR, UPI Gateway & 6-Month Member History
releaseNotes: Universal QR: Now points to permanent public HTTPS domain on GitHub Pages (https://iprashant2003.github.io/Chintamani-Library/) — reachable 24/7 on any mobile network
Member Portal: Complete 7-section luxury portal with dark obsidian & gold aesthetic
Member Registration: Includes full details, live selfie preview, shift timing, and intelligent seat availability matrix
Intelligent Seats: Dynamic filtering by shift/batch; occupied seats locked, only available seats selectable
UPI Payments: Integrated Prashant Mani Tripathi UPI (prashantmanitripathi2003-2@oksbi) with official Google Pay QR image, one-click copy, and screenshot verification
Admin Verification: Instant approval/rejection with screenshot viewer, automatic seat occupation, and finance sync
Member Card History: Added prominent '6 Months History' button with 30-day, 3-month, 6-month and custom date horizon filters
Feedback & Reviews: 1-5 star ratings and reviews submitted directly to backend and local records
Account Self-Service: Private student lookup showing assigned seat, active plan, and expiry timeline
